newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan provincial governor James Soong says President Lee Teng-hui, Premier Lien Chan oppose phase-out of provincial government
--Interior ministry approves foreign investments in real estate business in Taiwan
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to raise ceiling amount for national health insurance premium
--Taiwan governor James Soong says phase-out of provincial government will hamper national development
LIBERTY TIMES - Government land at expensive Hsinyi development area sold at record T$2.72 billion
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to allow ships with 100 percent mainland China ownership to ferry cargoes to and from Taiwan
--Premier Lien Chan says China's "one country, two systems" proposal unacceptable
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry to allow sales of pension fund insurance policy
--Taiwan, China exchange documents on direct shipping between Taiwan and Hong Kong in post-handover period
